title: Kiln Firing Service (Gas and Electric)
source_quote: LUX Center for the Arts Ceramics Center offers ceramic firing services in Lincoln, NE. Our electric kilns can be fired up to cone 6 and we fire our gas kiln up to cone 10.
evidence_sentence: LUX offers gas kiln firing service to cone 10 and electric kiln firing service to cone 6 at per-cubic-inch rates or kiln rental rates.
evidence_quote: we fire our gas kiln up to cone 10
summary: Gas reduction kiln firing service available to the public at cone 10 ($0.08 per cubic inch); electric kiln firings also available at lower cones with per-piece or rental pricing.
cost_text: $0.08 per cubic inch to cone 10 in gas kiln; electric kiln rental $60–$100 per firing
kiln_style: soft brick cone 10 reduction kiln called 'Gas Daddy'
